description: Unofficial toolbox for Kanzi Studio and startup animation files from VAG MIB2 and VC.
question: What do you want to do with them?
menu: 5 - Build custom files with provided assets
P - Pull .kzb files directly from MIB
select: Select an option and press ENTER:
continue: Press ENTER to return to the menu...
invalid_option: Unknown option. Choose one of the listed shortcuts.
no_files: No input files found. Use input/kzb/, input/canim/ and input/atlas/.
optimised: Built {path} — {count} changed embedded textures, {saved} container bytes saved.
empty_resource: Warning: {name} is empty in the source KZB.
unknown_header: Warning: {name} has an unrecognised header profile; the known container structure was checked.
missing_custom_folder: Missing custom folder. Mirror the input family and subfolders under custom/, e.g. custom/canim/brand/name/img_1.png or custom/kzb/name/Resource Files/... .
empty_custom_folder: The custom folder contains no replacement assets.
missing_png_optimizer: PNG optimiser missing. Install oxipng, optipng or pngcrush (tools used by ImageOptim) and add it to PATH. See README.
missing_jpeg_optimizer: JPEG optimiser missing. Install jpegtran or jpegoptim (tools used by ImageOptim) and add it to PATH. See README.
optimise_note: Lossless mode. KZB uses image optimisers; CANIM recompresses identical decoded data; raw atlases retain their container size and export optimised PNGs.
custom_note: Custom files: mirror the input family/subfolders under custom/<family>/<name>/. Keep extracted asset paths. CANIM supports colour promotion; atlas channel layouts are preserved.
integrity_note: Dry run: validates KZB objects, CANIM zlib/buffers and atlas pixels/JSON mappings. Unsupported files are reported as failures. Runtime animation/rendering semantics and full JPEG pixels are not checked.
pull_note: Read-only SCP download. Downloads go to output/pulled/; input/ is never changed. Copy downloaded originals into input/ manually when ready.
host: MIB hostname or IPv4 address (ENTER cancels):
remote_folder: Absolute remote folder containing .kzb files (ENTER cancels):
legacy: Use legacy SCP for QNX without SFTP? [Y/n]:
invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IPv4 address without spaces or shell symbols.
invalid_port: SSH port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
invalid_remote_path: Use an absolute remote path without spaces or shell symbols.
scp_failed: SCP failed. Check the connection and SSH authentication. Partial downloads may remain in output/pulled/.
about_libraries: Python standard library only. Optional external tools: oxipng, optipng, pngcrush, jpegtran, jpegoptim and OpenSSH scp. Third-party tools are not bundled.
about_notice: Unofficial project. Not affiliated with Volkswagen Group or Rightware. Runtime compatibility of modified files must be tested on the target system.
cancelled: Task interrupted. Partial extraction results may remain in output/.
bye: See you on the yellow brick road!
cli_description: Dorothy — unofficial Kanzi Studio CLI toolbox
cli_task: Run one task without the interactive menu
input_jobs: {count} input jobs: KZB, CANIM and atlas/JSON pairs; unsupported files are reported.
missing_atlas_companion: JSON metadata has no matching .atlas file. Place the pair in the same folder.
unsupported_input: Unsupported input file type; no integrity check or conversion is available for this file.
canim_optimisation: CANIM stores raw pixels inside zlib. Trying lossless zlib strategies; image pixels and animation commands remain identical.
atlas_optimisation: Atlas stores uncompressed pixels: container unchanged. Exported PNGs saved {saved} bytes; see exported/ beside the output atlas.
